notes: Food Code is a categorical identifier for a specific food item. It should be mapped to a Standard Concept in the Observation table, but the specific concept_id depends on the mapping of NHANES food codes to OMOP Nutrition or Food concepts. The value_as_concept_id field stores the coded result.
Short Food Code Description is a text label for the food code. It is stored as a string in the Observation table alongside the coded value (DRXFDCD) to provide context.

Long Food Code Description is a detailed text label for the food code. It is stored as a string in the Observation table, typically as an additional attribute or in a separate row with a different observation_concept_id if a structured approach is needed.
